title: Average active transactions at a fixed completion rate
method: Synthetic stable workload completes 400 transactions/second. Little’s Law L=λW gives 8, 20 and 40 average active transactions for mean service times 0.020, 0.050 and 0.100 seconds. Excludes pool wait and is not a pool-size recommendation.
alt: Average active transactions at a fixed completion rate. 20 ms service time: 8 active transactions; 50 ms service time: 20 active transactions; 100 ms service time: 40 active transactions. Illustrative values.
